understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete every level by moving each selectable piece onto a goal tile marked '+'. When multiple goals existed, all of them had to be occupied simultaneously for the level to report WIN and finish the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces moved one grid cell per directional action, with positions represented in pixel coordinates and typically changing by 3 pixels. Selectable pieces could be switched using CLICK with their pixel-coordinate position. Adjacent pushable blocks could be pushed when moving into them, while walls and boundaries generally blocked movement, though the blocked hints were not always definitive and movement had to be tested.

understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete every level by moving each selectable piece onto a goal tile marked '+'. When multiple goals existed, all of them had to be occupied simultaneously for the level to report WIN and finish the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces moved one grid cell per directional action, with positions represented in pixel coordinates and typically changing by 3 pixels. Selectable pieces could be switched using CLICK with their pixel-coordinate position. Adjacent pushable blocks could be pushed when moving into them, while walls and boundaries generally blocked movement, though the blocked hints were not always definitive and movement had to be tested.
